name_input: AECO ENGINEERING LLP; AECO ENGINEERING LLP
note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of 2026-11-23. No public risk record could be established for an Indian entity named 'AECO Engineering LLP' (claimed Maharashtra). Search tooling was partly degraded: the DuckDuckGo/searx backend returned connection errors, so web_search returned no results; fallback was direct http_get to Bing and to registry/aggregator sites. Bing queries for the exact name (with and without 'India', 'Maharashtra', 'Pune', 'limited liability partnership', 'Russia', 'sanctions', 'court', and site-restricted to zaubacorp.com / tofler.in / thecompanycheck.com / indiamart.com) returned only unrelated foreign 'AECO' entities (aecocorp.com, aeco.com, aeco.no, aecosensors.com, aeco.tw, AECOM) - no Indian LLP page at all. zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403; tofler.in search returned a 404 page. OFAC Sanctions List Search page was reachable (SDN list last updated 11/23/2026) but its lookup is a JS form that cannot be queried via plain HTTP GET, so no name-level OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS screening result was obtained - sanctions_hit is therefore null (NOT a clean bill of health, simply unverified). No Indian court docket (eCourts/NCLT/HC), no regulator action, no credit rating and no negative news could be located or attributed to this entity; all set to null rather than inferred. No evidence of supplies to Russia or the CIS was found - but note this is absence of evidence from a failed search, not verified absence. Per project rules, absence of sanctions/court/negative-news data is NOT a rejection ground and no rejection is proposed; the entity stays in the database. Recommended follow-up before any commercial reliance: (1) obtain the LLP's actual LLPIN/registration number and registered address from the supplier directly, since the name alone is not resolvable in public sources; (2) re-run OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS screening by name and by LLPIN once identifiers are known; (3) check eCourts and NCLT by party name and by LLPIN; (4) request GSTIN to confirm active registration and state of operation. Legal identity, HS codes and shipment volumes were deliberately not researched per role scope.
